notes.title: User Feedback Patch #2
notes.content:
Added additional support and bug fix for height adjustment.
Additional environmental Art and interactive foliage added

More to come!

notes.title: User Feedback Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added In-game options, including a smooth locomotion toggle, input, audio, and more
[*] Added a scene skip feature (experimental)  
[*] Added height adjustment slider to the in-game menu
[*] Removed red X from non-locomotion areas when using teleport 
[*] customized color and transparency of teleport arch  
[*] Expanded the first room in Ionia to include secret hallways
[*] Interactive astroids added to the dream sequence, Myth of Pan
[*] The difficulty of the Tablet Puzzle has increased
[*] Finding Slug Fruit to feed the Ocarina is redesigned to extend exploration
[/list]

Shout out to everyone on our Discord and feedback from reviews for helping make Ionia even better. Many more features and expansion of gameplay are on the way!

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content: Fixed several collision bugs in the first chapter.

notes.title: Steam Fix 2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed blocking volume in the climbing area in Valley of Harmony (missed in the last update)
[*] Increased default movement speed 
[/list]

notes.title: Release Day Feedback Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Release Day Feedback Fixes:[/b]

Fixed fading black while climbing in the first chapter
Fixed going black in the first stairwell 
Fixed collision issues in "Ionian Journey"
Fixed falling through floor at Ladder in "Ionian Journey"
